body:
Sometimes it feels like we're just not ourselves anymore. At some point along the way, we lost our voice and our unique point of view. To get back in touch with your true self, use Sodalite stone. Sodalite healing properties are often recommended for artists who are suffering from creative blocks. But sodalite is really for anybody whose energy seems to be in a lackluster slump. Sodalite fills you with therapeutic energies of self-acceptance, self-esteem, trust and confidence to remind you of all the fantastic attributes that make you who you are.

By fusing with your throat chakra, sodalite cleanses you of the blocks that are inhibiting you from your self-expression. If low self-esteem has you questioning whether or not you should speak up, use sodalite to put those negative notions in check. Sodalite will have you thinking like your best self again. From the positive thoughts that sodalite inspires, you'll find yourself more compelled toward positive actions. Your revitalized outlook will spawn new creativity. Because you are seeing things from a different point of view, you have an alternative take that can provide an interesting perspective in your work, your relationships and your passions.

Let sodalite bring a sense of harmony to your emotions so that your spiritual scale is tipped less toward the side of stress and sadness. Sodalite meaning has a calming effect on your body, bringing soothing and balancing energies into your spiritual field. One of the most important sodalite stone properties is that it provides you insight into the self, helping you to take a deeper look at your strengths, weaknesses and your desires and goals. The Sodalite stone meaning is also very beneficial for deepening your meditation. Combine your sodalite stone with other blue gemstones, such as Lapis Lazuli, Dumortierite and Aquamarine, to strengthen the harmonizing energies and cleanse your third-eye chakra.

If you feel pulled in by the energy of a sodalite stone, you may be experiencing a block in your throat chakra. Work with sodalite to clear your fifth chakra so that you can speak your truth. Speak from your heart instead of your head.

You may also be drawn to sodalite for its connection to the third eye chakra if you need to deepen your sense of self. Use a sodalite stone to open up your third eye and tap into your intuition. With this expanded understanding of who you truly are, you can more fully express yourself.
